The material provided is inconsistent. The company is identified as DXC Technology Co, a public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, with ticker DXC and CIK 0001688568. However, the text harvested from the website at dexus.com describes Dexus, an Australasian real estate and infrastructure investment and funds management business, and refers to Dexus (ASX: DXS). The site text does not describe DXC Technology, and no AI products or AI positioning appear anywhere in the provided data.

Per the harvested site text, the company describes itself as having four decades of expertise in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, with a multi-billion dollar portfolio. The text also references Atlassian Central in Sydney reaching a height of more than 180 metres, a Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds, and commentary on Australia's real asset markets amid elevated interest rates. These items are drawn from the site text as written and do not align with the DXC Technology identity in the held facts.

The held facts add little beyond the corporate record: no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers are listed. The only litigation-related field records Virginia as the jurisdiction with a count of 152. Given the mismatch between the company identity and the harvested site content, this profile should be treated as unverified.
